svg.aria-label: Set a list element, in memory. Give the element at a random index a new value — an element of its own, not a delete and an insert. Nothing touches the disk. ops/s, log scale, higher is better. Not shown: Yjs (no element of its own to set); TinyBase (no list that merges by position); PouchDB (no list that merges by position); RxDB (no list that merges by position); Fireproof (no list that merges by position); GUN (needs its storage adapter to answer in Node.js); OrbitDB (no list that merges by position).
